Update for Minecraft 1.21.11 (Fabric, on Linux, Windows and macOS).

### New

- **Performance setting.** Under **Display → Performance**, **Effects** can be **Auto**, **Full** or **Light**. Light draws a cheaper glow for more FPS. Auto switches to light effects on its own when the game slows down, and back when it speeds up again. The **Right now** line shows your FPS and which effects are on.
- **World words can stay in one place.** In the **World** layout, the **Direction** setting now applies. **Follow** works as before (new words appear wherever you look). Pick **N**, **E**, **S** or **W** and the words gather in that part of the sky, so you can look around and find them there when you look back.

### Better

- **World words read better by day.** Against a bright daytime sky the floating words get a darker shadow (and a darker glow if Glow is on), so they stand out. Words that are fading away lose their shadow first, so they melt into the sky instead of leaving grey smudges. Night looks the same as before.
